directory.name: Stevie's Famous
directory.note: Burien-founded, Seattle Times reader-poll pizzeria that opened its first Seattle-proper flagship in the former Zeek's Pizza space on Phinney Ave N in July 2026.

directory.name: Sinners Pizza
directory.note: Heaven-and-Hell-themed late-night New York-style pizza shop and bar that opened April 10, 2026 on the Ave in the former Supreme Pizzeria & Bar space.

directory.name: Roma Roma
directory.note: Brothers Forrest and Colin Brunton's Roman-style by-the-cut pizza counter, priced by weight, that opened on 12th Ave in the former Rachel's Ginger Beer space.
